sentences.text: This ancient bird possessed a skull featuring deep temporal fossae, an elongate narrow beak, and a short mandibular symphysis.
Its wing skeleton displays a combination of primitive traits seen in Waimanu and derived features shared with later penguins.
Perudyptes fills a roughly twenty million year gap between the earliest penguins and later partial skeletons.
It is a basal penguin found in the Middle Eocene Paracas Formation of Peru.
The genus Perudyptes was described by Clarke and colleagues in 2007.
The only known species within the genus is Perudyptes devriesi.
The genus name Perudyptes honors the country of Peru.
The species name devriesi honors Thomas DeVries, a science teacher who worked in Peru.
Perudyptes belongs to the order Sphenisciformes.
Perudyptes devriesi lived approximately 42 million years ago in the Middle Eocene of Peru.
Perudyptes lived between 48.07 and 41.03 million years ago during the Lutetian stage.
